T3_about.text: Molecular Quality Controls and Panels is an Exact Diagnostics range from Bio-Rad for molecular diagnostics. The catalog covers transplantation, virology, STIs, microbiology, hospital-associated and respiratory infections, and tick-borne diseases. The listed selection includes products for JCV and CT/NG. Material composition and the number of levels or concentrations depend on the individual test.

items.text: According to the manufacturer, ddPCR establishes target values for some products, while selected values are calibrated to WHO international standards.

items.q: What are Exact Diagnostics molecular controls?
items.a: They are Bio-Rad quality controls and verification panels for molecular diagnostics.

items.q: Which areas does the range cover?
items.a: The range covers transplantation, virology, STIs, microbiology, hospital-associated and respiratory infections, and tick-borne diseases.

items.q: What does the molecular control range include?
